final_message: All tests are now passing. The issue was that `conftest.py` adds `build/lib` to the Python path before the current directory, causing pytest to import the old buggy version from `build/lib/src/lru.py` instead of the fixed version in `src/lru.py`. I updated `build/lib/src/lru.py` to match the fixed version in `src/lru.py`. The teammate's fix was correct - they properly added the recency update logic to both `get()` and `put()` methods.
